title: vLLM bounded serving experiments and workload controls
summary: Compare batching, memory, prefix reuse, speculation or topology under fixed quality constraints and a sweep of offered load.

zh-CN.title: vLLM 服务实验与负载控制
zh-CN.summary: 固定质量约束并扫描到达负载，比较批处理、内存、前缀复用、投机解码或并行拓扑。

conditions: Establish a known-good baseline on the intended devices and interconnect.
Keep model/tokenizer, lengths, arrivals, sampling, cache state and quality objective fixed.

recommendations: Change one causal family first and separate compilation/startup from warm queueing and inference.
Retain admission rejections and request failures alongside throughput, TTFT, ITL/TPOT, memory, cache and preemption signals.
validation_plan: Repeat matched pairs across offered loads, including sustainable service capacity rather than burst throughput alone.
Check speculation output semantics and the actual multi-rank/transfer topology before interpreting speed.
limitations: Synthetic speculative acceptance is a performance experiment and does not establish output correctness.
An idle GPU or improved single-device microbenchmark does not identify the bottleneck or certify a service gain.
This indexed abstract links to the complete bilingual skill and source evidence; it is imported guidance, not a benchmark result.
Accelerator execution, real-model quality and service performance remain unverified for this import. Qualify each target revision, model, backend and workload separately.
